Bank Rate maintained at 5% - September 2024

Published on 19 September 2024

Monetary Policy Summary, September 2024

At its meeting ending on 18 September 2024, the MPC voted by a majority of 8-1 to maintain Bank Rate at 5%.

A gradual approach to removing policy restraint remains appropriate in the synthetic outlook.
